kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem execute-log-query --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --role-for 1733260000000 --log-user-id 1733260000000 --log-region-id cn-hangzhou --log-project-name slsaudit-center-1733260000000-cn-hangzhou --log-store-name huawei-cn-cfw --log-query 0 --log-condition alert_level_:_5_,_4_,_3_,_2_,_1 --extend-content-packed enabled --normalization-schema-id WAF_ALERT_ACTIVITY --start-time 1733269771123 --end-time 1733269771123 --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecuteLogQuery

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of the threat analysis feature is located. Select the management center region based on the region where your assets reside. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: Assets are located in the Chinese mainland.
ap-southeast-1: Assets are located outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response messages. Valid values:
zh (default): Chinese.
en: English. This parameter is required. If not specified, the service returns a 400 error. Explicitly set this parameter to zh or en
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文。此参数实际为必填项；未提供时服务返回 400 错误，请显式指定 zh 或 en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member account that the administrator switches to
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en: The user ID for data access
parameters.name: log_user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the log storage region. This parameter is required when executing a log query
parameters.help_zh: 日志存储地域ID。执行日志查询时此参数实际为必填项
parameters.name: log_region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the Simple Log Service project. This parameter is required when executing a log query
parameters.help_zh: 日志服务项目名称。执行日志查询时此参数实际为必填项
parameters.name: log_project_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the Simple Log Service project. This parameter is required when executing a log query
parameters.help_zh: 日志服务项目名称。执行日志查询时此参数实际为必填项
parameters.name: log_store_name

parameters.help_en: The Simple Log Service query statement
parameters.name: log_query

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to pack non-standard fields into the extended field extend_content. Valid values:
enabled: Enabled.
disabled: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
用于标识否将非标准字段打包到扩展字段extend_content。取值：
enabled：开启。
disabled：禁用
parameters.name: extend_content_packed

parameters.help_en: The NormalizationSchemaId to specify if packing is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 如果启用打包，则需要指定NormalizationSchemaId
parameters.name: normalization_schema_id

parameters.help_en: The start time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds (ms)
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间。使用 Unix 时间戳表示，单位为毫秒（ms）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds (ms)
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。使用 Unix 时间戳表示，单位为毫秒（ms）
parameters.name: end_time
